description: Source code for the CropCycle class and related functions in the ERPNext agriculture module, handling crop cycle management, task creation, disease management, and spatial analysis.

classes.name: CropCycle
classes.description: Represents a crop cycle with methods for validation, project and task creation, and disease management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the crop cycle, setting missing values.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Creates crop cycle project and disease tasks after insertion.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets crop spacing and row spacing units if missing.

methods.name: create_crop_cycle_project
methods.description: Creates a project for the crop cycle.

methods.name: import_disease_tasks
methods.description: Imports treatment tasks for a disease.

methods.name: create_project
methods.description: Creates a project document with expected dates.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates tasks within a project based on crop tasks.

methods.name: reload_linked_analysis
methods.description: Reloads linked soil and plant analysis data and publishes it.

methods.name: append_to_child
methods.description: Appends documents to child tables and saves.
